title: MUSCLE MANGA - Akoya "The Executioner" Seishu's Physique in Kengan Ashura
summary: A Muscle Manga episode on Akoya Seishu from Kengan Ashura, the vigilante cop who kills criminals on the spot. NH covers his huge forearm-dominant physique and his puppeteered fighting style, then argues that his absolutist idea of justice turns him into the monster he hunts.
claims: Justice is a subjective notion that passes itself off as universal truth, and that social instability is what produces vigilantes
Vigilante justice is dangerous because it puts deliberation and punishment in the same hands, so the vigilante decides alone what counts as an offence and what it costs
Absolutist worldviews do not survive examination because they are not built on logic, which makes them easy to turn back on the person who holds them
Akoya is listed at 191 cm and 114 kg, a muscle mass many tall men would kill for, but what impresses most is how it is distributed: his forearms look nearly as big as his legs
Akoya's 75 ms reaction time is beyond human; an average adult reacts in about 225 ms, the fastest in the high 100s, and below 100 ms is not considered possible
NH says he once sprained his intercostal muscles and the pain made the rib-nerve torture scene nauseating to watch
Akoya illustrates Nietzsche's warning that whoever fights monsters risks becoming one; fighting absolute evil with absolute means consumed him
Akoya is an example of what a man with immense physical strength can do once his soul is consumed by madness
